sentences.japanese: 教師は自らの権威を頼みとしてはならない。
sentences.english: Teachers shouldn't fall back on their authority.

sentences.japanese: 議長は自らの見解を非公式に述べるだけだろう。
sentences.english: The chairman would only make her comments off the record.

sentences.japanese: 患者はただ自らの病気に屈して死ぬことがよくある。
sentences.english: Patients often die simply because they yield to their diseases.

sentences.japanese: 我々は自らの文化を次の世代に伝えていかなければならない。
sentences.english: We have to transmit our culture to the next generation.

sentences.japanese: 我々は自らの文化を次の世代に伝えていかなくてはならない。
sentences.english: We have to transmit our culture to the next generation.
